title: Walker, Texas Ranger
description:
S5 E511 — Lucky
Walker's friend Father Blake is besieged by a ruthless developer who plans to build shoddy condominiums on the same site that the priest has announced plans to build a shelter for the homeless.

title: Walker, Texas Ranger
description:
S5 E512 — The Deadliest Man Alive
An assassin is in Dallas to kill an ambassador. A Russian agent who has been tracking the assassin for 25 years asks Walker to help with the capture and prevent the murder.

title: Walker, Texas Ranger
description:
S5 E513 — A Ranger Christmas
Walker tells children a Christmas story about a Texas Ranger from 1876. Hayes Cooper was said to have no Christmas spirit. In 1876, a baby was kidnapped and Haynes was assigned the case. At last, he found the baby and Christmas spirit.

title: Walker, Texas Ranger
description:
S5 E514 — Mayday
Walker transports a mob accountant on a plane so he can testify in court. The mob leader wants him dead, so he causes the plane to crash. Walker and the survivors must find their way from the crash site to safety while the mob chases them.

title: Diagnosis Murder
description:
S8 E2 — Blind Man's Bluff
While driving, David tells his wife Laura that he wants a divorce. Laura becomes hysterical and begins to cry and hit him. Trying to fight off his wife's attacks, David loses control of the car and flies into an intersection.

title: Diagnosis Murder
description:
S8 E3 — Sleight-Of-Hand
Jim, the hospital janitor, teaches Dr. Sloan some magic tricks. Jim is a whiz at magic and can nimbly manipulate a medallion between his fingers.

title: Diagnosis Murder
description:
S8 E4 — By Reason Of Insanity
George, a schizophrenic homeless man, shows up on a beach prophesizing about death. The couple in the nearby beach apartment, Cynthia and Ethan, threaten to call the police.

title: Diagnosis Murder
description:
S8 E5 — The Patient Detective
When Steve Sloan is hospitalized for injuries sustained in a high-speed car chase, he wakes in a haze and watches with a blurred vision what looks like another patient being stabbed by one of the medical staff in his room.

title: Diagnosis Murder
description:
S8 E6 — The Cradle Will Rock
Nurse Stacy Bradshaw tells Dr. Sloan about her skydiving escapades, and he politely turns down her extreme thrill-seeking invitation to come along.

title: Diagnosis Murder
description:
S8 E7 — Hot House
Dr. Travis catches Dr. Sloan in his office, settling in with a bowl of popcorn to watch a reality television show, "Hot House," a "Big Brother" and "Real World" type series.

title: Diagnosis Murder
description:
S8 E8 — All Dressed Up And Nowhere To Die
Mark's friends Stanley and Tammy have decided to preview Tammy's new fashion line at their wedding.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S7 E5 — Incident At Brewer's Pond
When mischievous Cowboy Habersham leads his buddies to a field to steal watermelons for a raucous party at a local lake, no one could predict that the night would end in the murder of Donnie Cole; a murder tangled in a web of infidelity and deceit.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S7 E6 — A Love Lost
Sheriff Bill Gillespie's daughter Lana learns that her old flame, Lee Thompson, has arrived in Sparta and may be illegally running guns to a local hunting store owner, Raymond Mercer. He’s caught the attention of Lonnie Jamison, who fears the worst.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S7 E7 — Singin' The Blues
While singing at her boyfriend Troy’s nightclub, LuAnn Corbin discovers that he is being forced by a shady drug dealer from his past, Brent Shaw, to use the club as a cover to sell Ecstasy. LuAnn is torn between love and her duty as an officer.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S7 E8 — Virgil Tibbs: Attorney At Law
Former Chief Detective Virgil Tibbs returns to Sparta and is instantly assigned his first case as a lawyer, representing an accused murderer, Delbert Pike. Pike claims it was self-defense, but the victim’s wife was a witness and says it was murder.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S7 E9 — Every Man's Family
After his nephew Matt almost dies from a drug overdose, Bubba Skinner travels to Atlanta, Georgia to help him overcome his addiction to heroin. While investigating Matt’s drug supplier, he teams up with an undercover detective, Walker Harris.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S7 E10 — A Baby Called Rocket
Sergeant LuAnn Corbin takes temporary custody of an abandoned baby boy found at a crack house after a drive-by shooting is reported in the Bottoms. When the infant’s young mother, a crack addict, comes to reclaim the boy, LuAnn struggles to let go.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S7 E11 — Little Girl Lost
Tragedy strikes Sparta when a young alcoholic woman, Holly Maynard, kills a child, Denia Larson, in a hit-and-run accident; however, a second and unexpected tragedy sadly follows, which will expose certain tragic failures of the justice system.
